about: Why an inference server didn't start, read from its log (models/postmortem.rs). Cases are tried in order against the decisive lines, then the whole log; every pattern in `all` must match (case-insensitive regexes). Titles are at most 60 characters and hedged; {placeholders} are filled from the log and the deployment. `flag` names the launch option to quote from a host-mounted script. `sample` is a log excerpt the case must match, with `expect` its title once filled (tests).

cases.title: No attention kernel for a {kv} KV cache on {gpu}
cases.explanation: {model} uses sparse MLA attention. On {gpu} (compute {cc}) {vllm_build} has one kernel for it, FlashInfer's SM120 sparse MLA, and that kernel doesn't accept a {kv_long} KV cache; Triton MLA has no sparse support.
cases.fix: Check the model's recipe for a compatible checkpoint, image and KV cache type. Changing the KV cache type alone may not fix this. SparkBox doesn't change your launch script.
cases.sample: (Worker_TP0 pid=251) ERROR 10-26 22:21:14 [multiproc_executor.py:944] ValueError: No valid attention backend found for cuda with AttentionSelectorConfig(head_size=512, dtype=torch.bfloat16, kv_cache_dtype=bfloat16, block_size=None, use_mla=True, has_sink=False, use_sparse=True, use_mm_prefix=False). Reasons: {TRITON_MLA: [sparse not supported], FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_SM120: [kv_cache_dtype not supported, kv_cache_dtype not supported]}.
cases.expect: No attention kernel for a bf16 KV cache on GB10

all: CUDA out of memory|OutOfMemoryError|cudaErrorMemoryAllocation|out of memory while
cases.title: Likely ran out of GPU memory while starting
cases.explanation: The engine asked CUDA for more memory than was free. On {gpu} the GPU shares the node's memory with everything else, so other processes and the page cache count against it.
cases.fix: Likely fix: lower --gpu-memory-utilization or --max-model-len, or free memory on the node first. SparkBox doesn't change your launch script.
cases.sample: (EngineCore_DP0 pid=212) ERROR 10-27 09:14:02 [core.py:708] torch.OutOfMemoryError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 3.50 GiB. GPU 0 has a total capacity of 119.70 GiB of which 1.12 GiB is free.
cases.expect: Likely ran out of GPU memory while starting

all: NCCL.*(timeout|timed out|unhandled system error|remote process exited)|Watchdog caught collective operation timeout|DistNetworkError|(Connection refused|ECONNREFUSED).*(MASTER|:29[0-9]{3}|TCPStore)|TCPStore.*(Connection refused|timed out)
cases.title: The nodes likely couldn't reach each other (NCCL)
cases.explanation: The ranks didn't finish setting up their collective links: one timed out or was refused while connecting to the head at its master address and port. A rank that started late, a wrong interface in NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME, or a fabric link that's down does this.
cases.fix: Likely fix: check that every rank uses the same master address and port, that the fabric links are up, and start the ranks together. SparkBox doesn't change your launch script.
cases.sample: (Worker_TP1 pid=240) ERROR 10-27 11:02:44 [multiproc_executor.py:944] torch.distributed.DistBackendError: NCCL error in: ProcessGroupNCCL.cpp:3356, unhandled system error (run with NCCL_DEBUG=INFO for details), NCCL version 2.28.3
cases.expect: The nodes likely couldn't reach each other (NCCL)

cases.title: Its port was likely already taken
cases.explanation: Another program was already listening on the port the server asked for, so it couldn't open its own.
cases.fix: Likely fix: stop what holds the port (Workloads › Listening ports shows it) or start it on another --port. SparkBox doesn't change your launch script.
cases.sample: (APIServer pid=1) ERROR 10-27 12:00:01 [api_server.py:1210] OSError: [Errno 98] error while attempting to bind on address ('0.0.0.0', 8000): address already in use
cases.expect: Its port was likely already taken

all: GatedRepoError|Cannot access gated repo|Access to model .* is restricted|401 Client Error|403 Client Error|Repository Not Found .* (401|403)
cases.title: Hugging Face likely refused the download (gated or no token)
cases.explanation: Hugging Face answered 401 or 403: the repo is gated and the node's token hasn't been granted access, or no token was given.
cases.fix: Likely fix: accept the model's terms on huggingface.co with the account whose token the node uses, or download it once in Models. SparkBox doesn't change your launch script.
cases.sample: huggingface_hub.errors.GatedRepoError: 401 Client Error. Cannot access gated repo for url https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct/resolve/main/config.json.
cases.expect: Hugging Face likely refused the download (gated or no token)

cases.title: The disk likely filled up
cases.explanation: A write failed with no space left on the device: the weights, the compile cache or the container's own layer didn't fit.
cases.fix: Likely fix: free space on the node (Files › Disk usage) and start it again. SparkBox doesn't change your launch script.
cases.sample: OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device: '/root/.cache/vllm/torch_compile_cache/3f1a/rank_0_0'

all: HF_HUB_OFFLINE|offline mode is enabled|LocalEntryNotFoundError|Cannot find the requested files in the (disk|local) cache
cases.title: Weights likely missing while offline (HF_HUB_OFFLINE)
cases.explanation: Hugging Face's offline mode was on, so nothing could be downloaded, and a file the model needs wasn't in the folder or the cache.
cases.fix: Likely fix: copy the full model folder to every node (Models › Library), or turn offline mode off for the first start. SparkBox doesn't change your launch script.
cases.sample: huggingface_hub.errors.LocalEntryNotFoundError: Cannot find the requested files in the disk cache and outgoing traffic has been disabled. To enable hf.co look-ups and downloads online, set 'HF_HUB_OFFLINE=0' as environment variable.

all: (placement group|Ray cluster|ray\.init|GetTimeoutError|wait_for_nodes).*(timed out|timeout|Timeout)|Timed out .*(Ray|placement group)|Current node has no GPU available
cases.title: The Ray cluster likely didn't form in time
cases.explanation: The head waited for the other nodes to join Ray and gave up: a worker didn't start, started late, or couldn't reach the head's Ray port.
cases.fix: Likely fix: start the workers first (ray start --address), check they show in ray status, then start the head. SparkBox doesn't change your launch script.
cases.sample: ValueError: Timed out waiting for the placement group to be ready: the Ray cluster has 1 GPU, 3 are needed. Is every node in the Ray cluster?
cases.expect: The Ray cluster likely didn't form in time

all: (quantization|quant_method|scheme|kernel).*(is not supported|isn't supported|not supported (on|for) (this|the current) (GPU|device|platform))|Unsupported quantization|requires (a GPU with )?compute capability|minimum capability
cases.title: Its quantization likely isn't supported on this GPU
cases.explanation: The weights' quantization needs a kernel this vLLM build doesn't have for {gpu} (compute {cc}).
cases.fix: Likely fix: use a variant made for Blackwell (NVFP4 or FP8), or a newer engine image. SparkBox doesn't change your launch script.
cases.sample: ValueError: The quantization method awq_marlin is not supported for the current GPU. Minimum capability: 80. Current capability: 121.
cases.expect: Its quantization likely isn't supported on this GPU

all: Engine core initialization failed|EngineCore failed to start
cases.title: vLLM's engine didn't start; the first error is quoted
cases.explanation: vLLM's engine stopped while starting and its log names no known cause. The first error it printed is quoted below.
cases.fix: Read the quoted lines and the log around them. SparkBox doesn't change your launch script.
cases.sample: (APIServer pid=1) RuntimeError: Engine core initialization failed. See root cause above. Failed core proc(s): {}
cases.expect: vLLM's engine didn't start; the first error is quoted
